hook: A choir of oozes that sings moss onto the board at the start of every fight.
loop: Buy oozes that spread moss onto your board
Moss layers pile up and survive selling
Payoffs cash every layer into stats

growth.line: Most growth lands at the start of each fight, then fades after combat.

feel.early: Quiet: a few layers, small bodies.
feel.mid: Fight starts begin to burst with moss.
feel.late: Every fight opens with a flood of moss.

stars.why: The fight-start moment: moss bursts out across the board.
Now fires once a turn, so it chains without running away.
A Tier 1 that starts the spread from turn one.

card_short.u01: When played, spread one layer of moss.
card_short.u02: Gains Health each turn while you have moss.
card_short.u03: Spreads moss when you sell it.
card_short.u04: Gains Attack whenever a friend gets moss.
card_short.u05: When played, gives a mossy friend +2/+2.
card_short.u07: Spreads two moss when it dies.
card_short.u08: Eats one friend's moss for a big body.
card_short.u09: Spreads moss at fight start for each mossy friend.
card_short.u10: Mossy buys pay 1 gold next turn.
card_short.u11: Taunt. Mossy neighbours take less damage.
card_short.u12: Each turn, your leftmost mossy unit gets +2/+2.
card_short.u13: Your first spread each turn spreads again.
card_short.u15: Every spread adds one more layer.
card_short.u16: When it dies, friends grow per moss layer.
card_short.u17: Fight start: spread three, mossy units +2 Attack.
card_short.u18: Strips all your moss for +4/+4 per layer.
card_short.u19: Sold mossy units keep half their moss.
card_short.x01: A 1/1 that spreads moss when it dies.

builds.name: Go wide
builds.line: Fill the board early; Tier 4 payoffs scale everything.

builds.name: One big carrier
builds.line: Pour all the moss into one unit behind Taunts.

liked: The best moments of the three designs.
Fight starts feel like a performance.
worries: Damp Nibbler is the weakest card.
It took three passes to stop breaking.
changed: Silt Mother capped at three spreads.
Old Root Choir fires only on the first spread each turn.
First Note renamed and given 2 Attack.
verdict: Fair now, with big fight-start moments, though the first version had more character.
